original_value: COVID-19, a deadly disease that originated in Wuhan, China, has resulted in a global outbreak. Patients infected with the causative virus SARS-CoV-2 are placed in quarantine, so the virus does not spread. The medical community has not discovered any vaccine that can be immediately used on patients infected with SARS-CoV-2. The only method discovered so far to protect people from this virus is keeping a distance from other people, wearing masks and gloves, as well as regularly washing and sanitizing hands. Government and law enforcement agencies are involved in banning the movement of people in different cities, to control the spread and monitor people following the guidelines of the CDC. But it is not possible for the government to monitor all places, such as shopping malls, hospitals, government offices, and banks, and guide people to follow the safety guidelines. In this paper, a novel technique is developed that can guide people to protect themselves from someone who has high exposure to the virus or has symptoms of COVID-19, such as having fever and coughing. Different deep Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) models are implemented to test the proposed technique. The proposed intelligent monitoring system can be used as a complementary tool to be installed at different places and automatically monitor people adopting the safety guidelines. With these precautionary measurements, humans will be able to win this fight against COVID-19.

result.paraphrase: COVID-19, a fatal illness that began in Wuhan, China, has caused a worldwide outbreak. People infected with the responsible virus SARS-CoV-2 are quarantined to prevent further transmission. The medical community has not yet found a vaccine that can be used immediately for patients infected with SARS-CoV-2. So far, the only known way to protect people from this virus is to keep physical distance, wear masks and gloves, and wash and sanitize hands regularly. Government and law enforcement agencies are enforcing restrictions on people’s movement across various cities to curb spread and monitor compliance with CDC guidelines. However, the government cannot monitor every location, such as shopping malls, hospitals, government offices, and banks, or ensure that people follow the safety guidelines there. In this paper, a new technique is developed to help people protect themselves from individuals with high exposure to the virus or with COVID-19 symptoms such as fever and coughing. Several deep Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models are used to evaluate the proposed technique. The proposed intelligent monitoring system can serve as a complementary tool installed in different places to automatically monitor whether people are following the safety guidelines. With these precautionary measures, humans can win this fight against COVID-19.
